findings.title: Require admin authorization for the bulk export
findings.comment: `handle_export_all` uses `@authenticated`, which accepts ordinary members, even though it reads and returns every tenant's documents. A request to `/exports/all` with `tok-ana` returns Globex's document contents as well as Acme's, violating the documented admin-only route and tenant isolation. Replace this decorator with `@admin_only` so non-admin sessions receive 403 before any cross-tenant reads.

findings.title: Return the saved revision rather than the row count
findings.comment: `handle_put_document` still uses the return value of `save_document` as the response's `revision` and ETag, so returning `len(rows)` now sends incorrect revision metadata whenever the row count differs from the stored revision. Creating a three-row document reports revision 3 while storing revision 1; a subsequent conditional PUT using the reported revision then fails with 409 despite no intervening write. Return `current + 1`, or update the handler to retrieve the actual saved revision before constructing its response.

findings.title: Use an exclusive end index for each document page
findings.comment: `last` is already `first + limit`, but the slice adds another entry, so pages return up to `limit + 1` documents and overlap the next page. With documents `a`, `b`, and `c` and `limit=1`, page 1 returns `a,b` and page 2 returns `b,c`; the advertised 200-entry cap can likewise return 201 entries. Slice with `names[first:last]` to honor the limit and avoid duplicate documents during pagination.
